items.source: Filter all handler functions routed by this function with the given filter function.
items.translation: 使用给定的过滤器函数过滤由该函数路由的所有处理器函数。

items.source: Return the handler function that matches the given request.
items.translation: 返回与给定请求匹配的处理器函数。

items.source: a composed function that first routes with this function and then the other function if this function has no result
items.translation: 一个组合函数，首先使用此函数进行路由，如果此函数没有结果，则使用`other` 函数。

items.source: predicate - the predicate to test if this route does not match
items.translation: predicate - 用于测试此路由是否不匹配的谓词

items.source: The map provided to the consumer is "live", so that the consumer can be used to overwrite existing attributes, remove attributes, or use any of the other Map methods.
items.translation: 提供给消费者的 Map 是“活的”，因此消费者可用于 覆盖现有属性、移除属性，或使用任何其他 Map 方法。

items.source: The default implementation calls RouterFunctions.Visitor.unknown(RouterFunction); composed RouterFunction implementations are expected to call accept for all components that make up this router function.
items.translation: 默认实现会调用RouterFunctions.Visitor.unknown(RouterFunction)；组合的RouterFunction实现预期会为此路由函数的所有组成部分调用accept。

items.source: Return a composed routing function that routes to the given handler function if this route does not match and the given request predicate applies. This method is a convenient combination of and(RouterFunction) and RouterFunctions.route(RequestPredicate, HandlerFunction).
items.translation: 返回一个组合的路由函数，如果此路由不匹配且给定的请求谓词适用，则路由到给定的处理函数。此方法是 and(RouterFunction) 和 RouterFunctions.route(RequestPredicate, HandlerFunction) 的便捷组合。

items.source: Return a composed routing function that routes to the given router function if this route does not match and the given request predicate applies. This method is a convenient combination of and(RouterFunction) and RouterFunctions.nest(RequestPredicate, RouterFunction).
items.translation: 返回一个组合的路由函数，如果此路由不匹配且给定的请求谓词适用，则路由到给定的路由器函数。此方法是 and(RouterFunction) 和 RouterFunctions.nest(RequestPredicate, RouterFunction) 的便捷组合。

items.source: Return a composed routing function that first invokes this function, and then invokes the other function (of the same response type T) if this route had no result.
items.translation: 返回一个组合的路由函数，该函数首先调用此函数，然后如果此路由没有结果，则调用other函数（具有相同的响应类型T）。

items.source: Return a composed routing function that first invokes this function, and then invokes the other function (of a different response type) if this route had no result.
items.translation: 返回一个组合的路由函数，该函数首先调用此函数，然后如果此路由没有结果，则调用other函数（具有不同的响应类型）。

items.source: Return a new routing function with the given attribute.
items.translation: 返回具有给定属性的新路由函数。

items.source: T - the type of the handler function to route to
items.translation: T - 要路由到的处理器函数的类型

items.source: an Mono describing the HandlerFunction that matches this request, or an empty Mono if there is no match
items.translation: 描述与此请求匹配的HandlerFunction的Mono，或者如果没有匹配则为空Mono。

items.source: other - the function of type T to apply when this function has no result
items.translation: other - 当此函数没有结果时，要应用的类型为 T 的函数。

items.source: a composed function that route to handlerFunction if this route does not match and if predicate applies
items.translation: 一个组合函数，如果此路由不匹配且predicate适用，则路由到handlerFunction。

items.source: a composed function that route to routerFunction if this route does not match and if predicate applies
items.translation: 一个组合函数，如果此路由不匹配且predicate适用，则路由到routerFunction。

items.source: S - the filter return type
items.translation: S - 过滤器返回类型

items.source: request - the request to route
items.translation: request - 要路由的请求

items.source: other - the function to apply when this function has no result
items.translation: other - 当此函数没有结果时应用的函数

items.source: handlerFunction - the handler function to route to if this route does not match and the predicate applies
items.translation: handlerFunction - 如果此路由不匹配且谓词适用，则用于路由到的处理函数。

items.source: routerFunction - the router function to route to if this route does not match and the predicate applies
items.translation: routerFunction - 如果此路由不匹配且谓词适用，则用于路由的函数。

items.source: filterFunction - the filter to apply
items.translation: filterFunction - 要应用的过滤器

items.source: a function that has the specified attributes
items.translation: 具有指定属性的函数

items.source: the filtered routing function
items.translation: 过滤路由功能

items.source: Represents a function that routes to a handler function.
items.translation: 表示一个路由到 处理器函数 的函数。

items.source: Accept the given visitor.
items.translation: 接受给定的访问者。

items.source:
Return a composed routing function that routes to the given router function if this
route does not match and the given request predicate applies.
items.translation: 返回一个组合的路由函数，如果此路由不匹配且给定的请求谓词适用，则路由到给定的路由器函数。

items.source:
Return a composed routing function that routes to the given handler function if this
route does not match and the given request predicate applies.
items.translation: 返回一个组合的路由函数，如果此路由不匹配且给定的请求谓词适用，则路由到给定的处理程序函数。

items.source: Return a new routing function with attributes manipulated with the given consumer.
items.translation: 返回一个使用给定消费者操纵属性的新路由函数。

items.source: name - the attribute name
items.translation: name - 属性名称

items.source: value - the attribute value
items.translation: value - 属性值

items.source: attributesConsumer - a function that consumes the attributes map
items.translation: attributesConsumer - 一个消费属性映射的函数

items.source: visitor - the visitor to accept
items.translation: visitor - 要接受的访问者

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: Arjen Poutsma
items.translation: Arjen Poutsma
